name: pickup_init
description: Pickup mission initialization binds the scene root, resets the pickup type table runtime fields, attaches matching class templates, parses pickup.zrd PICKUP_DATA overrides, and registers the Pickup archive section.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent pickup.cpp source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41ccf0 validates the ecx scene-node and edx pickups.zrd path ABI, default snd_pickup lookup, 40-entry pickup type reset/template loop, pu%03d template lookup in class bucket 6, template payload writes at name offsets 0x18/0x1c/0x20, PICKUP_DATA logical-name iteration, SOUND override with default fallback, optional IMAGE lookup, loaded-tree free, Pickup ZAR section registration at sort order 300, and 1/0 return behavior.

The native smoke builds a mounted pickup.zrd archive, registers a pu007 template and sound registry, verifies scene/template/default field side effects, confirms SOUND override selection, and checks Pickup archive section registration callbacks.
